summary: Own lazy optional-module loading and contribution registration for one enabled experiment and window.

faults.when: A registered optional module failed to load; preserve the ordinary Studio and offer Try again.

lifetime: While the effective experiment preference and root-window demand remain true; disabling immediately aborts registration and all feature work.
x-catalogue: Platform experiment metadata includes ID, label and a lazy loader; Hair Lab code is not statically imported by registry, views, renderers or exporter composition.
x-disable: Ignore late dynamic-import completion after abort; withdraw registered nodes and UI contributions. JavaScript modules already imported may remain cached until page reload.
x-startup: The shell mounts synchronously with an all-off port. A driver-owned background read loads experimental preferences; failure becomes a failed, off experiment state and never prevents ordinary Studio startup. Startup writes no preference node. The first successful set creates one stable preference identity, and storage refusal is surfaced in place. The desktop supplies no experiment definitions until its worker/assets route is supported. The composition root supplies its verification boolean and worker source options.
x-document-persistence: Only authored groom configuration enters persistent commits. Rebuild sampled density and scalp binding per geometry revision in the worker. A new groom waits for its baseline cap seed, whose identity stays independent of the selected Character hairstyle; later head/body rebuilds use that same source. Scalar edits write their individual field paths; no whole solved groom or derived arrays enter Undo history. Session results and continuation remain transient.
